announcement.goals.grand_witch: Spread Witch Factors with your primary ability (50 mana, 20s cooldown). announcement.goal.saint: Set yourself as bait and burden your Hellfire killer with Karma.
announcement.goals.saint: Help the passengers. Complete tasks for 50 coins; invoking Hellfire costs 175 coins. You have limited sprint stamina and cannot pick up guns. Civilian-side players cannot kill you; Voodoo may bind you, but its final chained death is canceled. After a 60-second initial cooldown, invoke Hellfire for 15 seconds. If a non-civilian player other than Grand Witch kills you during it, that killer is burdened with Karma until the round ends unless they later become Grand Witch, which clears the mark permanently. After each successful player kill, timed-bomb transfer, or poison-needle hit, every cooldown-capable item type in their inventory, hotbar, and offhand enters cooldown for 5 seconds, or 20 seconds if their current role is Bomber. Longer existing cooldowns are preserved. Item cooldowns already applied before becoming Grand Witch expire normally. Surviving Hellfire starts a 60-second cooldown.

item.sparkwitch.hunter_trap.tooltip.line: - Place a trap on the targeted surface; it arms after 0.5 seconds.
- Victims are rooted for 3 seconds and gain one Fracture stack.
- Fracture blocks sprint and stamina recovery, slows 20% per stack, and each stack lasts 60 seconds.
- Native killers may coat a placed trap with a Poison Vial; poison lasts 40 seconds.
- Keep up to 2 traps. Sneak-use your own trap to reclaim it.
item.sparkwitch.double_barrel_shotgun.to: - Right-click the shotgun with a shell in your inventory, or use shells from the other hand.
- Straight shot with an effective range of 8 blocks.
- Load the second shell within 10 seconds of the first, or fire before reloading again.
- Firing cools down for 0.2 seconds with a shell left, or 30 seconds when empty; cannot fire or load during the first 60 seconds of a round.

skill.sparkwitch.witch_factor.name: Witch Factor
skill.sparkwitch.witch_factor.descriptio: Primary ability (default G): spend 50 mana to spread a factor to a living player within 8 unobstructed blocks; 20s cooldown. Both casters share a cumulative first-spread quota, default floor(opening players / 3). One factor per player; removal never refunds quota.
skill.sparkwitch.witch_factor.income: Factors from either caster grant each living Grand Witch 25 mana every 30s, or 40 from an Apprentice Witch and 60 from a Murderous Witch. Factors survive their source's death.
skill.sparkwitch.witch_factor.sanity: After 20s, new or inheriting holders receive a warning and join the blue-purple outline network. All instinct outlines and hiding rules take precedence. Holders with real sanity lose 10 sanity every 60s, or 30 for an Apprentice Witch.
skill.sparkwitch.witch_factor.transfer: On a player kill, transfer to an eligible killer, preserving income/sanity clocks but restarting the 20s admission delay. Grand Witch, Accomplice, Witch Maiden, Voodoo and Emma cannot carry factors. Environmental deaths, invalid or already marked killers remove the factor without refunding quota.
skill.sparkwitch.recruit_accomplice.name: Recruit Accomplice
skill.sparkwitch.recruit_accomplice.desc: After 2 tasks, use ability key 2 (default N) on a living player within 8 unobstructed blocks to force them into Accomplice. Free, no cooldown. Cannot recruit yourself or an existing Accomplice. Quota: one for every 6 round participants beyond 18, rounded down; successful recruits consume it permanently, even if they die. Accomplices are no longer assigned naturally.
skill.sparkwitch.recruit_accomplice.inve: Only keys, master keys, revolvers and letters remain. Other items, including food and drinks, convert to coins at shop value, or 25 each if unpriced. Existing coins are preserved; the new role's shop purchase limits reset.

tip.letter.judge.tooltip5: Sentenced players cannot complete player kills for 60 seconds, but their weapons and skills remain usable.
tip.letter.judge.tooltip6: Their orange outline yields to existing instinct colors and hiding rules. Invisibility hides the outline, not the sentence.
tip.letter.judge.tooltip7: An active sentence cannot be refreshed. After it expires, the player may be judged again.

tip.letter.time_stealer.tooltip4: Careful: a Pocket Watch kill takes 30 s off the round and can hand the passengers a time win. P.S.: Don't forget your instinct [Left Alt].
item.sparkwitch.time_stealer_pocket_watc: Use: steal time from the player you aim at within 7 blocks.
35 s later their time runs out; only a Timekeeper's purchase can save them.
45 s cooldown, also at round start. Hidden from other players.
item.sparkwitch.time_stamp.tooltip: Time Stealer shop currency, earned by Pocket Watch kills.

tip.letter.control_expert.tooltip1: You start with a revolver and 0 coins; each completed task grants 50 coins.
tip.letter.control_expert.tooltip2: Shop: Disruptor 100 and Taser 100 (one each), Shock Device 150 (consumable, re-buyable).
tip.letter.control_expert.tooltip3: Your items work only for you and start each round on a 30-second cooldown.
tip.letter.control_expert.tooltip4: Disruptor: every other player within 6 blocks loses instinct for 10 s. 90 s cooldown.
tip.letter.control_expert.tooltip5: Taser: stuns the player you aim at within 6 blocks (7.8 with Marksman). 30 s cooldown.
tip.letter.control_expert.tooltip6: Shock Device: throw it to stun everyone in a 3×3 area where it lands. 60 s cooldown.
tip.letter.control_expert.tooltip7: Stunned players lose instinct and all controls for 5 s and are slowed and blinded. Nothing here kills.
item.sparkwitch.disruptor.tooltip.line1: Use: every other player within 6 blocks loses instinct for 10 seconds.
item.sparkwitch.disruptor.tooltip.line2: Affected players are told privately; you are never affected.
item.sparkwitch.disruptor.tooltip.line3: Control Expert only. 90-second cooldown; 30 seconds at round start.
item.sparkwitch.taser.tooltip.line1: Use: stun the player you aim at within 6 blocks (7.8 with Marksman).
item.sparkwitch.taser.tooltip.line2: Stun: 5 s without instinct or controls, Slowness III and Blindness, then Slowness I for 10 s.
item.sparkwitch.taser.tooltip.line3: Control Expert only. Non-lethal. 30-second cooldown, also at round start.
item.sparkwitch.shock_device.tooltip.lin: Throw: stuns every other player in the 3×3 area where it lands.
Stun: 5 s without instinct or controls, Slowness III and Blindness, then Slowness I for 15 s.
Control Expert only. Non-lethal and consumed on use. 60-second cooldown; 30 seconds at round start.

shop.sparkwitch.taser.description: Stuns the player you aim at within 6 blocks for 5 seconds. 30 s cooldown.
shop.sparkwitch.shock_device.description: Throw to stun everyone in a 3×3 area for 5 seconds. Consumed on use; 60 s cooldown.

announcement.goal.seeker: Scout with your Search Car and cameras, and expose whoever breaks them.
announcement.goal.sparkwitch.seeker: Scout with your Search Car and cameras, and expose whoever breaks them.
announcement.goals.seeker: Scout with your Search Car and cameras, and expose whoever breaks them.
tip.letter.seeker.tooltip1: You start with a revolver, a Search Car and 50 coins; each completed task grants 50 coins.
tip.letter.seeker.tooltip2: Shop: Tablet 50 (one), Security Camera 150 (no limit; buy and place as many as you can afford).
tip.letter.seeker.tooltip3: Right-click the tablet to open the Seeker Console, then drive the car or watch any of your cameras (A/D switches between them). Shift returns you.
tip.letter.seeker.tooltip4: While controlling, your body is frozen and cannot sprint or interact; while driving, right-click makes the car open doors and press buttons.
tip.letter.seeker.tooltip5: Battery: 100% per deploy; driving drains 2% per second, idling 1% every 3 s. At 0% the car shuts down.
tip.letter.seeker.tooltip6: Recalling, breaking or an empty battery puts the car on a 180 s cooldown; it starts on 60 s.
tip.letter.seeker.tooltip7: Other players can break your devices. With a tablet in your inventory, the breaker is outlined for you for 10 s.
tip.letter.seeker.tooltip8: Players with instinct see your car through walls; a Taotie can swallow it until it dies or loses its role.
item.sparkwitch.seeker_car.tooltip.line1: Use: deploy the car at your feet or up to 3 blocks ahead.
item.sparkwitch.seeker_car.tooltip.line2: Control it from the Seeker Console; press Shift to return to your body.
item.sparkwitch.seeker_car.tooltip.line3: Battery: full on deploy; 2%/s while driven, 1% per 3 s while idle.
item.sparkwitch.seeker_car.tooltip.line4: Right-click the car to recall it. Recall, break or empty battery: 180 s cooldown.
item.sparkwitch.seeker_camera.tooltip.li: Use: mount it on a solid face within 4.5 blocks, away from doors, beds, seats and other interactive blocks.
View it from the Seeker Console and turn your head to look around.
Place as many as you like; while viewing, the strafe keys (A/D) switch cameras. Other players can break them.
shop.sparkwitch.seeker_camera.descriptio: A remote camera you can watch from the Seeker Console. Buy as many as you like.
shop.sparkwitch.seeker_tablet.descriptio: Opens the Seeker Console and joins the police network.

announcement.goal.fisher: Fish at the drink trays, live off your catch, and find the killers.
announcement.goal.sparkwitch.fisher: Fish at the drink trays, live off your catch, and find the killers.
announcement.goals.fisher: Fish at the drink trays, live off your catch, and find the killers.
tip.letter.fisher.tooltip1: You start with a Fishing Rod and earn 50 coins per task. Shop: Bait for 25 coins.
tip.letter.fisher.tooltip2: Hold the rod and use a drink tray to spend one Bait and catch a fish. Sometimes nothing bites.
tip.letter.fisher.tooltip3: Salmon, Cod, Clownfish, Goldfish: use to eat instantly and restore sanity. Clownfish adds Speed; Goldfish adds 50 coins.
tip.letter.fisher.tooltip4: Key Fish: opens one locked door or train door, then it is gone. Jammed doors stay shut.
tip.letter.fisher.tooltip5: Swordfish: works like a knife (hold to charge, release to stab), one use only. Kill an innocent and you die too.
tip.letter.fisher.tooltip6: Glimmerfish: full sanity, then for 7.77s you see everyone through walls, pass through doors, ignore player collision and turn invisible.
tip.letter.fisher.tooltip7: Pufferfish: puffs up on the tray and drains the sanity of anyone it pricks, you included.
tip.letter.fisher.tooltip8: Others cannot see your rod, bait or edible fish in hand; the Key Fish and Swordfish are visible. Eating fish never counts as the food task.
item.sparkwitch.fishing_rod.tooltip.line: Use on a drink tray: spend one Bait to catch a fish.
Others cannot see it in your hand.
item.sparkwitch.fish_bait.tooltip.line1: One is spent per cast. Others cannot see it in your hand.
item.sparkwitch.salmon.tooltip.line1: Use to eat: restores a tiny bit of sanity.
item.sparkwitch.cod.tooltip.line1: Use to eat: restores a little sanity.
item.sparkwitch.clownfish.tooltip.line1: Use to eat: restores some sanity and grants Speed for 10s.
item.sparkwitch.goldfish.tooltip.line1: Use to eat: restores a little sanity and grants 50 coins.
item.sparkwitch.glimmerfish.tooltip.line: Use to eat: fully restores sanity.
For 7.77s: see everyone, pass through doors, ignore player collision, turn invisible.
item.sparkwitch.key_fish.tooltip.line1: Use on a locked door or train door to open it; then it is gone.
item.sparkwitch.key_fish.tooltip.line2: Cannot open jammed doors. Others can see it in your hand.
item.sparkwitch.swordfish.tooltip.line1: Hold to charge, release to stab a player within 3 blocks. One use only.
item.sparkwitch.swordfish.tooltip.line2: Kill an innocent and you die too. Others can see it in your hand.
message.sparkwitch.fisher.pufferfish: You hooked a pufferfish! It is puffing up on the tray…
message.sparkwitch.fisher.inventory_full: Your hotbar is full; there is no room for a fish.

announcement.goals.potion_gunner: Help the Grand Witch complete her goal with potion shells.
announcement.goal.sparkwitch.potion_gunn: Help the Grand Witch complete her goal with potion shells.
tip.letter.potion_gunner.tooltip1: You are a special Accomplice recruited by the Grand Witch, with every Accomplice power: instinct, the witch cohort, and the tablet in the shop.
tip.letter.potion_gunner.tooltip2: Load your Anti-Tank Launcher in the inventory: left-click a shell, then right-click the launcher. One shell at a time; right-click it with an empty cursor to unload.
tip.letter.potion_gunner.tooltip3: Hold right-click to aim down the scope (with range marks) and left-click to fire. Shells fly straight for 50 blocks, then drop; they burst on impact and each enemy caught pays +15 coins. Mind the backblast: the nearest player within 4 blocks behind you is burned to death (a shield can stop it).
tip.letter.potion_gunner.tooltip4: GW-DK blinds and slows, GW-AC adds cooldown, GW-MR burns coins, all enemies only. TR kills everyone in range, you and your allies included.
In the inventory: left-click a shell, then right-click the launcher to load one. Right-click it with an empty cursor to unload.
Hold right-click to aim, left-click to fire.
item.sparkwitch.gw_dk_shell.tooltip: Enemies within 5×5 of the blast are blinded and get Slowness II for up to 7 seconds, less the farther they are.
item.sparkwitch.gw_ac_shell.tooltip: Enemies within 7×7 of the blast get 20% of each skill's and item's normal cooldown added, less the farther they are.
item.sparkwitch.gw_mr_shell.tooltip: Enemies within 3×3 of the blast lose up to 150 coins, less the farther they are.
item.sparkwitch.tr_shell.tooltip: Kills everyone within 5×5 of the blast, you and your allies included. Survivors are blinded, slowed (II) and set alight for 3 seconds; the fire deals no damage.
